turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My car insurance renewal just came in and it's gone up a lot.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's annoying. Do you want to shop around for a new quote, or call your insurer and ask them to match a better price?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me for a moment, my friend has a question. Don't talk until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, are you still playing that farming game?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Every night. I'm in my third year now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it worth getting? It looks kind of slow.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It is slow. That's the point. It's relaxing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can we play it together or is it single player?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: You can do co-op. Get it and I'll show you around my farm.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. We'd got to the renewal price. Any decision?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll just switch. I've been loyal for six years and look where it got me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair. Loyal customers often pay more, so switching usually pays off.
